attributes.action: Re-establish Capital Punishment for the purpose of punishing extreme racism
attributes.additional_details: In today's society, migrants and people of colour, native or not, face an extreme amount of racism in the form of both words and actions. Racist groups, such as those to which refer to themselves as "Patriots" fuel this type of behaviour by spreading the false narrative that these people are criminals. This ridiculous narrative is unfortunately both easily pushed and easily adopted by the less intelligent members of our society. This policy would help to deter this type of behaviour.
attributes.background: Introduce Capital Punishment as a sentencing option for people who are convicted of hate crimes against people of colour. The UK currently experiences a racism epidemic. A stop must be put to this, I believe this would be a step in the right direction to protect these people and punish offenders.

rejection.details: We are not clear what you are referring to when you use the term "extreme racism". Any petition calling for capital punishment needs to be clear on the exact nature of the crimes it is setting down for consideration in that respect.
